Messages.Author: bingotclown
Messages.Body:
Hey,

Is a blood hunt called by way of Abactor applicable to a vampire with
Trophy: Diablerie? I guess no as the blood hunt from Abactor is not a
cost or a prerequisite and the trophy makes him immune but I'm not
sure.

Trophy: Diablerie
Type: Master
Master. Trophy.
The vampire with this card gets +2 stealth when attempting diablerie.
Blood hunts cannot be called against this vampire. If this vampire
successfully diablerizes another vampire, burn this card at the end of
the action.

Abactor
Type: Action
+1 stealth hunt action.
Gain 5 blood. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to
call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as
if he or she had committed diablerie).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
bingotclown wrote:
> Is a blood hunt called by way of Abactor applicable to a vampire with
> Trophy: Diablerie?

No. Blood hunts cannot be called on him.
